SELECT , l.name AS lab_name, l.code AS lab_code FROM mentor m JOIN lab l ON l.id = m.lab_id WHERE m.lab_id = #{labId} AND m.enabled = 1 ORDER BY m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mentor (user_id, mentor_no, name, title, lab_id, research_direction, profile, quota, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{mentorNo}, #{name}, #{title}, #{labId}, #{researchDirection}, #{profile}, #{quota}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE mentor SET quota = #{quota} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mentor m WHERE m.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
